profile_text.body:
Braintrust is a San Francisco-based AI observability company founded in 2022. Its platform is designed to help engineering teams ship and maintain AI agents at scale by tracing production behavior, running evaluations, and catching regressions before they reach users. The company describes itself as an "active observability platform for agents" and emphasizes that AI systems can drift and regress silently, positioning continuous evaluation as a core part of responsible deployment.

The company's primary product, also called Braintrust, falls within AI governance and risk management. It combines datasets, scorers, CI quality gates, and prompt iteration informed by production trace feedback. The platform includes a feature called Loop, which the company describes as generating better prompts, scorers, and datasets automatically based on what a user wants to optimize. Braintrust also offers an MCP server that connects coding agents to a user's AI stack, enabling log queries, evaluation runs, and prompt updates directly from an IDE.

The site holds 181 California law exposure entries associated with the company, suggesting notable legal or regulatory surface area in that state, though no specific cases are recorded in the held facts.
